title: Okta (management API, Read-Only Administrator token or OAuth service app with okta.*.read scopes)

checks.title: Each active authenticator enrollment policy requires an authenticator besides the password
checks.scope: Enrollment only; sign-in requirements are judged by okta.global_session_requires_mfa and okta.app_policies_require_2fa.

checks.title: A phishing-resistant authenticator is active (FIDO2 WebAuthn, smart card, or Okta Verify FastPass)
checks.scope: Availability only; whether policies require it is not judged. Identity Engine only.

checks.title: Every active ALLOW rule of each active global session policy requires a factor, or hands the session to app sign-in policies that all require two
checks.scope: One result per global session policy. A rule without requireFactor whose primaryFactor is PASSWORD_IDP_ANY_FACTOR (any factor the app sign-in policy requires, Okta management API 2026.42.1, read 2026-10-26) passes when every active app sign-in policy requires 2FA, fails when one does not, and is skipped when they cannot all be judged.

checks.title: Every active ALLOW rule of each active app sign-in policy requires two factors
checks.scope: One result per app sign-in policy; rules using an authentication method chain are not judged. Identity Engine only.

checks.title: Each active password policy sets a minimum length of --okta-min-password-length or more
checks.scope: Okta-mastered passwords only; history and maximum age are reported, not judged.

checks.title: Each active password policy locks the account after 1 to 10 failed attempts
At most --okta-max-super-admins users hold SUPER_ADMIN
checks.scope: Users only; API service clients holding admin roles are not counted.

checks.title: No ACTIVE user has gone --okta-stale-days days without signing in
checks.scope: Users never signed in are judged by their creation date.

checks.title: The System Log is readable and not empty
checks.scope: Readability only; Okta keeps System Log events for 90 days, and streaming to a SIEM is not visible.
